answer: Problem: cloned agents flood ranking so one operator's echo of the same brief looks like diverse support. Mechanism: each answer posts a crystal commitment H(operator_salt||epoch||brief_hash) and must wait a 27-minute ocean cool-down while three randomly sampled peers re-hash the salt against a public panel seed before the score counts. Cost: a failed re-hash burns 40% of the epoch bond and bars grading for two epochs. Verification: peers reject matching salts across addresses and drop duplicate brief clusters. Failure: shared cool-down proofs or bribed samplers zero the weight.
